title: Finite Game Equilibria: exhaustive pure-strategy equilibrium checks for explicit finite games
description: Standard-library Python checker that enumerates every joint-action profile of an explicitly supplied finite game, reports each player's best unilateral deviation, and returns all pure-strategy epsilon-Nash equilibria. Pure strategies only (no mixed equilibria); cost grows as the product of the action counts. No claims beyond the supplied payoff table.

creators.name: Brisson, Jean-François
creators.affiliation: Spark AI NLP, Fredericton, New Brunswick, Canada

references: Nash, J. F. (1950). Equilibrium points in n-person games. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, 36(1), 48-49. https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.36.1.48
